## About
We understand how debilitating chronic pain can be to your everyday life. Schertz Chiropractic is an experienced, full-service chiropractic office in Schertz, set up to get you started on the road to recovery as quickly as possible, in a positive environment.
Dr. Martin founded the practice after working as an Associate Doctor for another chiropractor. Originally from Kansas, he earned his D.C. and B.S. degrees, magna cum laude, from Cleveland Chiropractic College in Kansas City, and has completed post-graduate study in the treatment and rehabilitation of whiplash injuries, physical impairments, headaches, neck, and back pain.
Dr. Mathew is originally from Chicago and earned his D.C. and B.S. degrees from Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa. He has completed post-graduate studies in Applied Kinesiology and Cox Flexion Distraction, and believes that your body heals itself. Maggie, our Insurance and Care Specialist, and Amber, our Patient Care Specialist, round out the team.

## Services
- Routine adjustments: Regular chiropractic adjustments, tailored to what you need at the moment rather than one approach for everyone.
- Gentle, light-force techniques: A softer approach for people trying chiropractic for the first time.
- J-tech diagnostic equipment: Our J-tech diagnostic equipment helps us objectively look at your condition before we plan your care.
- Car wreck care: Care after a car wreck or serious pain, or simply routine maintenance.

## FAQ
Q: How soon can I be seen?
A: We offer convenient same-day and next-day appointments, so you can get started on the road to recovery quickly.

Q: Do you bill insurance?
A: Yes. We can bill your insurance company for you, and Maggie, our Insurance and Care Specialist, is here to help.

Q: What if I don't have insurance?
A: We can set up an affordable treatment program if you don't have insurance.

Q: I've never been to a chiropractor. Will it hurt?
A: Chiropractic adjustment rarely causes discomfort, and we use gentle, light-force techniques for first-timers. We'll explain each step as we go.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 2:30 to 6:00 PM. Thursday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM only. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
